title: Real Engine save
description: A save file: `saves/<slot>.json` in the data folder.

$schema.description: An optional JSON Schema reference, for a seed written by hand.

data_version.description: The game's data version: `[saves] version` of the build that wrote it.

saved_at.description:
The run's `os.time()` when the slot was written: seconds since 1970,
UTC.

data.description:
The game's data: the table `save.write` was given, as JSON (an array
for a table with the keys 1 to n, else an object).
